purpose: Lag-aware snapshot of market expectations and positioning; not a standalone direction signal

source.report: CME Futures Only Commitments of Traders long report
coverage_limits: CME futures only; excludes global spot, offshore perpetuals and options
Legacy non-commercial classification can include directional, spread and hedging activity

aggregate_assessment.confirmed_fact: Across CME BTC, ETH, XRP and SOL contracts, non-commercial net longs increased because shorts fell faster than longs; outright non-commercial longs declined in all four contracts.
aggregate_assessment.inference: The apparent improvement in net positioning is lower quality than broad fresh-long accumulation and may leave upside moves vulnerable if concentrated longs reduce exposure.
alternative_explanations: Contract roll or portfolio hedging can change long, short and spreading positions without a directional view
CME positioning may diverge from spot and offshore derivatives
The three-day reporting lag may omit subsequent position changes
bullish_confirmation: Spot-led price advance with expanding real volume
Open interest rebuilds without excessive funding or basis
Verifiable fund flows and BTC/ETH market structure confirm demand
bearish_confirmation: Price rises while open interest and spot volume contract
Funding, basis or call skew becomes extreme before a structure break
Large-cap weakness spreads to high-beta assets during concentrated long reduction
aggregate_assessment.invalidation: A later COT report or real-time cross-market data shows broad fresh-long accumulation with non-extreme leverage and spot confirmation.
aggregate_assessment.permitted_use: Raise confirmation threshold and avoid treating net-long growth alone as bullish evidence.
aggregate_assessment.prohibited_use: Do not open, close, size or reverse a position from this snapshot alone.

next_expected_update: After the next official weekly CFTC COT release or a material revision
